==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I attained lucidity via self induced sleep paralysis. I convinced the alligator men to stop pillaging.
I did so by showing them that their fangs could be used as valuable talismans to transform others into Were-Gators.
They now sell fangs to elves to raise money peacefully for their leader.
